title: 向量資料庫相似度搜尋
subcategoryTitle: 神經網路、資料與視覺系統
subcategoryTitleEn: Neural networks, data and visual systems
summary: 以向量距離、近似索引與召回成本串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect vector distances, approximate indexes and recall cost with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 表示與距離
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「表示與距離」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop representations and distances through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 表示版本：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「表示版本」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for representation versions.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「表示版本」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給合成向量加模型與維度版本。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for representation versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「表示版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給合成向量加模型與維度版本。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for representation versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具向量 x=(3,4)、y=(4,3)，範數皆為 5，餘弦相似度=24/25=0.96，Euclidean 距離=√2≈1.414。單位向量距離平方=2(1−cos)=0.08；未正規化時此式不能直接沿用。
knowledge.textEn: Toy x=(3,4), y=(4,3) both have norm 5, cosine 0.96 and Euclidean distance sqrt(2). For normalized vectors, squared distance is 2(1−cos)=0.08; the identity cannot be applied unchanged to unnormalized inputs.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「向量資料庫相似度搜尋」的「表示版本：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Representation versions: principles and architecture” in “Vector-database similarity search”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「表示版本」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for representation versions?
options: 維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。
不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「表示版本」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility.
Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates.
One matching output proves representation versions for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 因此「維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates. Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. The alternative "Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 表示版本：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「表示版本」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for representation versions.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「給合成向量加模型與維度版本。」；將結果與「不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Compare results against: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「表示版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for representation versions; explain why this claim fails: Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility.

steps.title: 精確基準：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「精確基準」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for exact baselines.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「精確基準」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：近似召回需對照窮舉精確搜尋。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在本地小向量集求精確 top-k。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for exact baselines. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Approximate recall needs exhaustive exact references. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find exact top-k on a small local vector set. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 在本地小向量集求精確 top-k。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An approximate index is its own exact ground truth. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「精確基準」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在本地小向量集求精確 top-k。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for exact baselines; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
